renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium Eclipse zodiac-guardian mutual-growth card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the approved named guardian pair or canonical internal pair, never a third guardian, unseen recipient, body clue, shadow, reflection, empty seat, or personal belonging implying another person. Use every named guardian's canonical element sheet. Preserve identity, relative size/colors, silhouette, clothes and signature props; dark-purple pupils and in EACH visible eye exactly one large plus one small highlight; chest Stella stars visible. Pair plus focal cluster covers 55–65% and reads at actual width80. Preserve every exact prop/count and keep personal lanes/roots/houses/stages/plants/stars/boxes/maps/stairs/tables/corals/currents distinct. Shared controls remain removable, half-set, unlatched, open-ended, or stoppable. Eclipse shadow divides only specified regions and never closes a heart, ring, route, gap or identity. Symbols/simple shapes only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, number, date, clock, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, map coordinate, actual constellation or birth-chart line, logo, watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Only Aries source heart1, Aquarius blue heart bottle1, and Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip1 are allowed; no other heart. No deterministic agreement, reply, growth, sacrifice, forgiveness, reunion. Follow compositionFamily/distinctFrom/focus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, plush proportions, dark-purple outlines.
